verdict.rationale: Gitea's source code is publicly hosted at github.com/go-gitea/gitea, with build-setup and development docs for building, linting, and testing locally. Community members critique specific internals of the codebase, which corroborates that the source is readable. Openness of the license is only implied by the public repo and its fork lineage, not stated in the evidence. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of the license name/terms (e.g., a LICENSE file citation), first-party docs stating the open-source licensing.
